story: At 5:17 on a humid, hazy Wednesday in Sumter Oaks, Gary heads off toward Town Square with a determined stride. On Magnolia Loop, Donna is busy tucking the extra flamingos behind the hedge so only three show from the street, while Rosa, optimistic as ever, asks her whether she'd like to bring dessert on Saturday or leave the whole menu to her. Back at his house, Hal sits content with his violation notebook, reviewing the open entries to make sure nothing else needs filing before the weekend.
events: Donna (donna flamingo flock): Tuck the extra flamingos behind the hedge so only three show from the street
Hal (hal violation notebook): Review the remaining open entries and confirm nothing else needs filing before Saturday

gary.thought_process: I've already submitted the cart modification request and checked its status once. Nobody's around, and the review desk is slow. Standing here sketching isn't getting me closer to a parade-ready cart. Under L-01 I can't touch the exterior until it's approved, but I can do the unseen work, like the wiring plan and the sound system, in my garage. I can't see the exterior mods from the street, and I need to watch L-03 quiet hours for testing. Best move: head back to the square and then home to start on the interior wiring, and let Architectural Review take its time.

parameters.content: Nothing more I can do at the desk today. Heading home to start on the wiring bench-work in the garage while Architectural Review makes up its mind.

donna.thought_process: Rosa just reminded me about the three-ornament limit and I already started counting my flamingos last tick. I've told her about Gary and the ladder, she's confirmed Saturday at six, and there's nothing left to say there. I shouldn't repeat myself. My real goal is to keep Gary on track as my doubles partner, and he's been reliable. Better to finish the flamingo chore properly, since L-02 is a real violation risk and I don't want the HOA talking about the social chair. Then I can go find Gary about practice.

parameters.content: Tuck the extra flamingos behind the hedge so only three show from the street

hal.thought_process: The cart and flamingo complaints are settled, and I've already crossed them out of the notebook. Nobody is around, it's a hazy evening, and Saturday at Rosa's is sorted. I've swept the street twice already today, so there's no sense burning another hour on the binoculars. I'll go over what's still open in the notebook, then maybe take a quiet look at whether anything else on the loop needs doing.

parameters.content: Review the remaining open entries and confirm nothing else needs filing before Saturday

rosa.thought_process: Saturday is locked in with Gary, Donna, and Hal, and the bulletin board note is already up. Donna is right here, but we've covered the dinner twice and I told her about the flamingos last tick, so repeating myself would just be noise. The one thing I haven't settled is a dish plan, and I'm tired of guessing. Since she's nearby, ask something new and useful: is she bringing a dessert, so I can finalize the menu and shopping before my next shift.

parameters.content: Donna, one practical thing before I go shopping: are you thinking a dessert for Saturday, or should I handle all of it? I'd rather plan the menu around what you're bringing.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
